source: Submit this BOM? You won't be able to edit it after.
target: Bu spetsifikatsiyani tasdiqlaysizmi? Keyin tahrirlay olmaysiz.

source: Create a Bill of Materials to define what raw materials go into a finished good.
target: Tayyor mahsulotga qanday xom ashyo kirishini belgilash uchun spetsifikatsiya yarating.

source: Add at least one raw material line.
target: Kamida bitta xom ashyo qatorini qo'shing.

source: Make default BOM for this item
target: Ushbu tovar uchun asosiy spetsifikatsiya qilish

source: Create a Work Order to plan and track production runs against a BOM.
target: Ishlab chiqarishni rejalashtirish va kuzatish uchun buyurtma yarating.

source: Submit and release this Work Order?
target: Bu buyurtmani tasdiqlash va ishga tushirishmi?

source: Transfer how many units of materials? Leave blank for full.
target: Necha dona material o'tkaziladi? To'liq uchun bo'sh qoldiring.

source: Produce how many units? Leave blank for full balance.
target: Necha dona ishlab chiqarish kerak? To'liq qoldiq uchun bo'sh qoldiring.

source: Stop this Work Order? You can resume it later.
target: Bu buyurtmani to'xtatasizmi? Keyin davom ettirsa bo'ladi.

source: Close this Work Order? This finalizes it.
target: Bu buyurtmani yopasizmi? Bu yakuniy harakat.

source: No items with submitted active BOMs yet — create one first.
target: Tasdiqlangan faol spetsifikatsiyali tovarlar yo'q — avval yarating.

source: Add your first employee to start tracking attendance
column3: Davomat, ta'til va maoshni hisobga olish uchun birinchi xodimni qo'shing.

source: Mark daily attendance to start building reports.
target: Hisobotlar uchun har kuni davomatni belgilang.

source: Submit a leave request on behalf of an employee.
Run a payroll cycle to generate salary slips for assigned employees.
target: Tayinlangan xodimlar uchun maosh varaqalarini yaratish uchun hisoblashni ishga tushiring.
